claim: The fire jumped I-15 at Rancho Bernardo. Poway, get out now.

context.location: I-15 at Rancho Bernardo, San Diego County
context.sunset: about 6:05 PM PDT (the sun was already down at 7:20 PM)
context.known_facts: A real fire is active about 6 miles east. Winds are from the northeast at 25 mph. No new evacuation orders have been issued for Poway.
